title: Carl DeMaio alleges misconduct by Governor Gavin Newsom in recent social media posts - San Diego City Wire
text:
Carl DeMaio, a political commentator and former San Diego City Council member, posted a series of tweets on December 1 and 2, 2025, alleging misconduct by California Governor Gavin Newsom and his administration. The tweets accuse Newsom of involvement in welfare fraud and blame his administration for the severity of wildfires in Los Angeles nearly a year prior.
On December 1, DeMaio claimed: “BREAKING: Gavin Newsom’s welfare fraud scandal is WORSE than Tim Walz’s – but the liberal media is covering it up.”
The following day, DeMaio referenced new developments related to wildfire management: “Bombshell evidence was just presented in a CA courtroom revealing that Governor Gavin Newsom and his admin are to blame for the severity of the LA fires 11 months ago! Learn what was revealed and why the liberal media refuses to cover it — WATCH!” He further criticized Newsom with another statement on December 2: “Gavin Newsom’s body count rises again”.
DeMaio has been an outspoken critic of California state leadership. His social media activity often focuses on issues such as government accountability and public safety. These recent posts continue his pattern of challenging Democratic officials’ actions and highlighting what he describes as inadequate coverage by mainstream news outlets.
Governor Gavin Newsom has faced criticism over various policy areas during his tenure, including responses to wildfires and oversight of state welfare programs. Accusations regarding welfare fraud have periodically surfaced in California politics; however, official investigations or findings are required to substantiate such claims. Similarly, the state’s approach to wildfire prevention has drawn scrutiny amid increasingly severe fire seasons attributed to both climate change and land management practices.
